summary:
Resolution 1: Shareholders adopted the Directors' Statement and Audited Financial Statements for FY2026 and the Auditors' report (100.00% for, carried).
Resolution 2: Shareholders re-elected Mr. Goh Hao Kwang, Dennis, as an Executive Director and CEO (100.00% for, carried).
Resolution 3: Shareholders approved Directors' fees of S$160,000 for FY2027 (100.00% for, carried).
Resolution 4: Shareholders re-appointed RT LLP as Auditor with authority to fix remuneration (86.62% for, carried).
Resolution 5: Shareholders approved the Share Issue Mandate authorising Directors to issue and allot shares (98.66% for, carried).
